brief:
Israeli forces struck a tent housing displaced Palestinians in a shelter camp near Al-Aqsa University west of Khan Younis in southern Gaza on Sunday, Shehab Wire reported. The strike wounded several Palestinians who had taken refuge at the site amid the ongoing displacement crisis in the enclave.

Local sources confirmed the tent was among structures targeted in the area. The incident occurred as thousands of Palestinians remain displaced across Gaza's south, sheltering in makeshift camps and informal settlements established near universities and public institutions.
